\subsection*{p.~289}A second above mark on a precomposed letter that already has one. \subsection*{Checked in context: not font problems}Encoding typos, not font problems. p.~85, (b), a starred example: \emph{ŋwàʼnyə̀ ̀ piŋ} has a second grave after a space, which prints as a loose grave after ə̀. p.~87, \emph{pe ́ exclude such DPs}: a space between e and U+0301, which prints as a loose acute; \emph{pé} is meant (as on the next line). The PDF also sets some IPA in the TIPA fonts (tipa8--10), which this scan does not see.\par\medskip
